name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx as a multi-site HTTPS web server, including site roots and virtual hosts, security tooling, host hardening, and development TLS certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, PID and log directories, service enablement, and Fedora-compatible settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs the Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites for a FastAPI application, deploys it from Git, configures its virtual environment and database, and runs it under systemd.
